description: add: add TITLE creates an open task and prints 'Added <id>'
list: list prints one line per task in id order, or 'No tasks'
steps: After two adds, lines are '1 [ ] Buy milk' and '2 [ ] Walk dog'

description: done: done ID marks done, prints 'Done <id>'; unknown id -> stderr 'No such task: <id>', exit 1
delete: delete ID removes the task, prints 'Deleted <id>'; ids are never reused
priority: --priority high|medium|low, suffix '(high)'/'(low)' (none for medium), list --sort priority, invalid -> 'Invalid priority: <v>'
steps: add a --priority high; list shows '1 [ ] a (high)'
list --sort priority orders high, medium, low, ties by id

description: tags: --tag repeatable, suffix '#work #home', list --tag work filters
steps: add a --tag work --tag home; list shows '1 [ ] a #work #home'
list --tag work shows only matching tasks

description: due dates: --due YYYY-MM-DD, suffix 'due:YYYY-MM-DD' (after tags), invalid -> 'Invalid date: <v>', list --overdue --today DATE
steps: --overdue shows only OPEN tasks due before --today

description: edit: edit ID --title NEW TITLE replaces the title, prints 'Edited <id>'
search: search TEXT: case-insensitive substring on title, same line format, or 'No matches'
export: export --format json|csv with the exact fields in SPEC.md
steps: csv: header id,title,done,priority,tags,due; done true/false; tags joined with ';'

description: stats: stats prints 'open: N', 'done: N', 'total: N'
undo: undo reverts the last add/done/delete/edit including next id; repeatable; history persists; 'Nothing to undo' exit 1
steps: undo after add removes it and the next add reuses that id
undo works through done, edit and delete in turn
